<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def birdpos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','Y'):
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    return None
print("before:", birdpos(current_frame))
res=action(['LEFT'])
print("after LEFT:", birdpos(current_frame), "step", current_frame.step)
def bsum(f): return sum(1 for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N')
print("N:", bsum(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
